token_family_docs.$description: Motion mode collection — animation preference. Modes: on (the base — no class is applied), off (.ob-motion-off). Each mode carries the CSS class string the application adds to <body> to activate it.

selector.$description: on is the base motion mode — no class is applied. It is the first-paint default.
Developer-facing class. The application adds it to <body> to turn motion off.
